claims: Crimson Desert is set to release globally on March 19, 2026.
Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure game from Pearl Abyss.
Crimson Desert will be available on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam/Epic.
Pre-orders for Crimson Desert are currently available.
Pre-loading for Crimson Desert begins around March 17-18, 2026, depending on the region.
Crimson Desert is a single-player game.
Pearl Abyss is the developer and publisher of Crimson Desert.
Crimson Desert was previously delayed to 2026 to allow for further development, according to IGN.
